name: Пішаковий ендшпіль (1)
description:
If the board becomes empty, this does not always mean that the complexity decreases. Even endgames with only kings and pawns can be incredibly complicated. There is even a kind of unwritten rule among grandmasters that they simply do not play pawn endgames: they are too complicated!

Of course, this does not apply to all pawn endgames. There are certain principles that are incredibly useful to learn, such as opposition.

Moreover, calculation skills are extremely important in pawn endgames. It is critical to calculate all options for both sides so that you ensure that your pawn reaches the other side first.

What do you have to do?

Calculate accurately by making sure that your pawn arrives at the other side first.

examples.text: Black has a protected passed pawn on h4. Now it is mainly a matter of black preventing white from promoting. After that the endgame wins easily.
This one is more complicated. It is important that white stops the black pawn. In addition, white also wants the black pawn to not be able to move to the c4 square to protect the b3-pawn.
